sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler; defines "animal control officer".

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county
sponsored.sum: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county.

sponsored.t: Suspends certain taxes on motor fuel and diesel motor fuel; repealer
sponsored.sum: Suspends certain taxes on motor fuel and diesel motor fuel until December 31, 2026.

sponsored.t: Establishes state-facilitated investment accounts for individuals under the age of eighteen
sponsored.sum: Establishes state-facilitated investment accounts for individuals under the age of eighteen; creates a tax deduction for certain contributions to such investment accounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanded approval power for actions taken at meetings of the New York state energy research and development authority
sponsored.sum: Expands approval power for actions taken at meetings of the New York state energy research and development authority to include the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, and the minority leader of the assembly.

sponsored.t: Provides a one-year utility bill tax and surcharge holiday and two-year green energy tax holiday
sponsored.sum: Establishes a one-year utility bill tax and surcharge holiday and a two-year green energy tax holiday.

sponsored.t: Relates to leucistic and melanistic deer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the hunting of leucistic deer, including white deer and albino deer, or melanistic deer; authorizes the hunting of such deer on private property.

sponsored.t: Requires two-thirds vote of legislature for any change in tax rates, budget bills and appropriations
sponsored.sum: Requires approval by 2/3 vote of membership of the senate and assembly voting separately to increase or decrease any tax rate, impose a new state tax, extend or delete existing state tax.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York advanced nuclear energy office
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York advanced nuclear energy office; establishes an advanced nuclear energy development fund to provide grants to assist in nuclear energy production in the state; authorizes such energy development fund draw from the environmental bond act of 2022 available for green buildings projects.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver before expiration of such license
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver at least 90 days before expiration of such license.

sponsored.t: Establishes a contraband screening plan which includes a canine at the entrance of each correctional facility
sponsored.sum: Establishes a contraband screening plan which includes a canine at the entrance of each correctional facility to detect the presence of illegal drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability and purchase of zero-emission school buses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability and purchase of zero-emission school buses.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to conduct a full cost benefit analysis on renewable energy systems; and makes changes in relation to greenhouse gas emission limits
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation; makes certain changes relating to greenhouse gas emissions limits.

sponsored.t: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry
sponsored.sum: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "ratepayer disclosure and transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ratepayer disclosure and transparency act" which requires a monthly report that includes the estimated or actual ratepayer costs and benefits of any mandated state energy program to the governor and legislature including any New York climate leadership and community protection act compliance costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
sponsored.sum: Permits instruction in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of all terrain vehicle or "ATV"
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of all terrain vehicles to include certain vehicles of up to seventy inches long and 1500 pounds.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state nursing shortage correction act; establishes the New York state nursing recruitment incentive and retention program; defines terms; provides for tuition benefits and the reimbursement of student loans if a person is a registered and licensed nurse; provides that SUNY and CUNY shall pay for a person's education if such person signs a contract stating that such person shall work in New York state as a registered nurse; makes related provisions; establishes the New York state nursing recruitment incentive and retention account.

sponsored.t: Creates the "Commission on Battery Fire Safety Practices"
sponsored.sum: Creates the commission on battery fire safety practices to evaluate the need for resources for police, volunteer fire departments and emergency medical services concerning health and safety best practices when responding to lithium-ion battery incidents.

sponsored.t: Relates to contraband screening at correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish contraband screening at correctional facilities including canines at the entrances and a third-party secure vendor mail program.

sponsored.t: Directs a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission in consultation with NYSERDA to conduct a full cost benefit analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of renewable energy systems in the state of New York and to compare such directly with other methods of electricity generation within nine months after the effective date and every four years thereafter.

sponsored.t: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple participating states, thereby enhancing the portability of a medical license and ensuring the safety of patients.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a statewide study and review of the transportation of individuals with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of transportation, in consultation with the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities, to conduct a statewide study and review of the transportation of individuals with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund reform act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund reform act; ensures that money deposited into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund is spent on construction purposes and not DOT and DMV operational activities.

sponsored.t: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software
sponsored.sum: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software.

sponsored.t: Establishes the marine electric propulsion health and environmental impact program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the marine electric propulsion health and environmental impact program to provide education, advocacy and increased awareness of the environmental and health impacts of marine electric propulsion systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to the health and environmental impacts of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, and the manufacturing thereof
sponsored.sum: Educates the public about the health and environmental impacts of lithium-ion battery use and manufacture on air, water and soil.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "cobalt and lithium mining and production divestment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "cobalt and lithium mining and production divestment act" to prevent monies or assets of the common retirement fund from being invested in the stocks, securities or other obligations of any institution or company engaging in cobalt and lithium mining or production for the manufacture of batteries used in large-scale battery storage power stations and the primary propulsion systems for electric vehicles, if such company cannot establish through approved independent monitoring that their mining operation does not use child labor and that adult miners and other workers are employed under conditions that meet accepted criteria.

sponsored.t: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide certain benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers; increases the personal income tax deduction after four or more years of service; exempts motor vehicles used in the performance of such volunteers' duties from registration fees, use taxes and special fees for volunteer license plates; authorizes the provision of municipal health insurance coverage to such volunteers; establishes a volunteer recruitment service loan forgiveness program.

sponsored.t: Relates to city reimbursement for state highway construction within such cities
sponsored.sum: Relates to city reimbursement for state highway construction within such cities; raises such rate from eighty-five cents to one dollar and eighty cents per square yard of the pavement area.

sponsored.t: Requires the deposit, into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund, of a portion of the sales tax collected on each gallon of motor fuel sold at retail; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the deposit, into the dedicated highway and bridge trust fund, of a portion of the sales tax collected on each gallon of motor fuel sold at retail; increases the amount to be deposited over time.

sponsored.t: Requires the county seat in Steuben county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Steuben county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Increases reimbursement rates paid by the state to cities for repair and maintenance of state arterials
sponsored.sum: Increases reimbursement rates paid by the state to cities for repair and maintenance of state arterials; provides rate would be raised to one dollar and eighty cents from eighty-five cents per square yard of the pavement area that is included in the state highway system and an additional twenty cents, up from ten cents, per square yard of such pavement area where such pavement area is located on any elevated bridge.

sponsored.t: Allows school resource officers to be hired with salary aidable to the school district; raises retirement salaries for such officers
sponsored.sum: Allows school resource officers to be hired with salary aidable to the school district; raises retirement salaries for such officers to fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a study on the public safety implications of the electrification of buildings and transportation in the context of emergency response
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a study on the public safety implications of the electrification of buildings and transportation in the context of emergency response and to issue a report on the findings and recommendations as a result of such study; exempts emergency services vehicles and heavy equipment from the requirements of the climate leadership and community protection act of 2019; prohibits the use of battery packs which contain cobalt mined components for primary propulsion of emergency services vehicles.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the elimination of building systems or equipment used for the combustion of fossil fuels in new building construction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the elimination of building systems or equipment used for the combustion of fossil fuels, including, natural gas, propane and fuel oil in new building construction.

sponsored.t: Permits animal-drawn vehicles to equip and use amber flashing lights
sponsored.sum: Permits animal-drawn vehicles to equip and use amber flashing lights; does not apply to such vehicles in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on carbon recapture
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of carbon recapture.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations, including criminal possession of methamphetamine manufacturing materials and unlawful manufacture of methamphetamines.

sponsored.t: Relates to minimum wage order increases
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative approval of minimum wage increases promulgated through wage orders.

sponsored.t: Establishes credits against income tax for a teacher's unreimbursed expenditures for qualified supplies
sponsored.sum: Establishes credits against income tax for a teacher's unreimbursed expenditures for qualified supplies.

sponsored.t: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting
sponsored.sum: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting.

sponsored.t: Relates to the possession and sale of methamphetamine
sponsored.sum: Makes penalties for the possession and/or sale of methamphetamine similar to that of the penalties for possession and/or sale of heroin and cocaine.

sponsored.t: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis.

sponsored.t: Provides that the election of chief and assistant chief by a fire department may be on the same day as the day of election of the fire department's election of administration officers
sponsored.sum: Provides that the election of chief and assistant chief by a fire department may be on the same day as the day of election of the fire department's election of administration officers.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on geothermal energy
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of geothermal energy.

sponsored.t: Requires that any rules or regulations promulgated by the department of environmental conservation pursuant to the climate action fund are subject to a vote of the legislature for approval
sponsored.sum: Requires that any rules or regulations promulgated by the department of environmental conservation pursuant to the climate action fund are subject to a vote of the legislature and must be approved by a majority vote prior to implementation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Schuyler correctional facility to also be used for the detention of persons under arrest and being held for arraignment in any court located in the county of Schuyler
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Schuyler correctional facility to also be used for the detention of persons under arrest and being held for arraignment in any court located in the county of Schuyler.

sponsored.t: Establishes a third-party secure vendor mail program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a third-party secure vendor mail program for the delivery of all products to incarcerated individuals housed at correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Increases the portion of real property taxes that a manufacturer may take as a business franchise or personal income tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases from 20% to 100% the portion of real property taxes that a manufacturer may take as a business franchise or personal income tax credit.

sponsored.t: Extends the maximum number of months for the reconsideration of denied applications for parole for certain felony offenses
sponsored.sum: Extends the maximum number of months for the reconsideration of denied applications by the parole board for parole for certain violent felony offenses from 24 months to 60 months.

sponsored.t: Establishes a climate action cost council; limits the number of rules and regulations that may be promulgated annually regarding certain climate goals
sponsored.sum: Establishes a climate action cost council; limits the number of rules and regulations that may be promulgated annually to meet CLCPA goals.

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church, for a certain property located in the village of Hammondsport, county of Steuben.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Montour to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Montour, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Designates certain portions of the state highway system as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail"
sponsored.sum: Designates certain portions of the state highway system between Cayuga lake and Seneca lake as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail".

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the Sergeant James S. Hayes Memorial Highway
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting a portion of state route 14 to Sergeant James S. Hayes.

sponsored.t: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Chemung county
sponsored.sum: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Chemung county.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.
